bars.description: Both sixteen-bar binary halves repeated. The canonical published MIDI is not unfolded; source soprano repeat marks supply the performed order. Lower-staff polyphony is retained together as a labelled staff.

endpoints.basis: Cached analysis has a quiet lead-in to about5s and a final melodic/cadential span285–290s; inspect exact attack and ornament overlays before publication.

anchors.label: repeated-A-G3-G5
anchors.basis: The repeated A section's G3/G5 attack peaks at76.88s. The initial unconstrained76.57s start was early; the following second G5/B3 near78.2s confirms the source order.

anchors.label: first-B-D4-A4
anchors.basis: VerS rejected the initial146.000s bar17 start inside the measured silent gap. The source D4/A4 entry has its measured combined peak147.28s, with the performed upper ornament beginning on a lower auxiliary. The editorial146s chapter label is not attack evidence.

anchors.label: first-B-following-E4
anchors.basis: The separate lower E4 half a quarter after the B entry peaks148.12s, not the initial model's146.756s. This establishes source order independently of the earlier editorial guide.

anchors.label: first-B-second-A4-F-sharp4
anchors.basis: The next F-sharp4/A4 pair begins at the148.70s local pitch rise. Later149.06s ornament energy is not a substitute for that first source attack; performed ornament notes are not invented in the MIDI.

anchors.label: repeated-B-D4-A4
anchors.basis: At the B repeat the D4 entry rises near217.64s, before the upper ornament's stronger218.1s A4 energy. Retain the actual lower-staff start rather than assigning the whole chord to a later ornament.

anchors.label: repeated-B-following-E4
anchors.basis: The repeated B section's separate E4 has its measured218.56s peak, following the D4 entry and preceding the next F-sharp4/A4 pair.

anchors.label: repeated-B-second-A4-F-sharp4
anchors.basis: The first rise of the repeated F-sharp4/A4 pair is near219.10s; the stronger219.38s ornament peak is later. All these constraints are disclosed source-pitch fitting, not independent or aural validation.

provenance: Read content/listen/bach-goldberg-aria.mjs and cache/analysis/bach-goldberg-aria.txt; harmonic trajectories recur around75s and220s, supporting both repeats provisionally.
Mutopia979 is the opening Aria, not the complete Goldberg cycle. The source is Bach-Gesellschaft keyboard notation; the recording is piano, not harpsichord.

Published MIDI staff tracks were inspected. The lower staff contains several written voices and occasional cross-staff notes; staff labels do not claim independent contrapuntal voices or reproduce the pianist’s ornament realization.
